list.name: Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.7
list.body:
## Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.7
**Release channel:** `beta`

### 🔧 Changed
- [DE] **An album's, a playlist's and an artist's artwork rounds its corners under the pointer, like a card's does.** The 128 dp cover of a detail header was the one cookie in the app that never moved: `GradientHeader` drew it with the fixed shape (`artworkShape = CookieShapes.fourSided`, passed in by the artist screen and defaulted everywhere else), while every card and every song row already took `rememberArtistCookie` and morphed. The header holds the hover state now and hands it to `rememberArtistCookie`, so the corner rounds toward the pointer anywhere on the header, not only over the picture's 128 dp - the app's own rule for a shape inside a hoverable surface, which is why `SongRow` and `YtItemCard` own theirs. The `artworkShape` parameter went with it: a shape that only ever had one value and could not morph was a parameter that said nothing, and the caller that passed it was the same static cookie. **Measured:** `:desktop:compileKotlin` passes. **Watch:** a cover takes its shape from `rememberArtistCookie`, not from a fixed `CookieShapes` value, when the surface it sits in has a pointer state. **Open sub-item:** no check here renders a detail header with a pointer on it, so the morph is verified as the wire from the header's interaction source to the shape, not as pixels; the card and row cases are the ones `:desktop:motionCheck` paints.

### 📝 Commits
- v6.0.8.11_DE-1.56.7-beta: a detail header's cover morphs

---
This release was built automatically from commit `db917132174ee92d1c40f964fa2b2c7d40084b3f`.

list.name: Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.6
list.body:
## Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.6
**Release channel:** `beta`

### ✨ Added
- [DE] **A bare `IconButton` fails the build now, so the rule "an icon button is an `M3IconButton`" is enforced instead of remembered.** The rule was written in `AGENTS.md` and had been applied by hand, which is why the icon buttons were converted in one sweep: nothing stopped the next one from being a bare `IconButton`, and its glyph would simply not lift or turn under the pointer, with nothing in the build to say so. The new `:desktop:iconButtonCheck` reads the module's Kotlin sources instead of the compiled output - this is a rule about what the code says - and fails naming the file and the line for any `IconButton(` call or any `import androidx.compose.material3.IconButton` outside the wrapper's own body in `Motion.kt`, which is the one call and the one import that `M3IconButton` is actually made of. It also fails if that wrapper disappears or if a second bare call is added next to it, so the single allowed occurrence cannot quietly become two. It is wired into `compileKotlin` rather than offered as a task alone, so a build of the module stops on it. **Measured:** `:desktop:iconButtonCheck` prints `OK: no bare IconButton; 74 icon button(s) go through M3IconButton` on the tree as it stands; a probe file holding a bare `IconButton` and its import makes `:desktop:compileKotlin` fail with `A bare IconButton is not allowed in the DE` and both lines named, and deleting the probe makes it pass again (the probe was not committed). `:desktop:compileKotlin` passes. **Watch:** the two `FilledIconButton`s (Listen Together's send and the Basic player's play) are a different Material family that takes its own container colour, are not matched here, and keep wrapping their glyph in `LiftedGlyph` themselves. **Open sub-item:** `:desktop:test` fails on its own, before and after this change (`There are test sources present and no filters are applied, but the test task did not discover any tests to execute`), which is why the rule is attached to the compile instead of `check`: a `check`-only wiring would sit behind a task that already fails for a reason that has nothing to do with it.

### 📝 Commits
- v6.0.8.11_DE-1.56.6-beta: a bare IconButton fails the build

---
This release was built automatically from commit `a1492def1e6972b87584d3da226a0de07c8e7a98`.

list.name: Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.5
list.body:
## Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.5
**Release channel:** `beta`

### 🔧 Changed
- [DE] **The Apple Music player's artwork casts the same shadow as the Basic player's, and that shadow is the cookie.** The cover on the Apple Music screen had no shadow at all, so the largest artwork of the two designs was the one that sat flat on the backdrop while the Basic player put a 24 dp shadow under its own. It is wrapped in `Modifier.shadow(24.dp, CookieShapes.fourSided)` now: the same elevation as the Basic player, drawn from the cookie's own outline, because a rounded rectangle there would put a square back around a shape that is not one (and would clip the rotated cover with a corner when the rotating-artwork option is on). The shape itself was already the 4-sided cookie in both designs through `PlayerThumbnail`. **Measured:** `:desktop:compileKotlin` passes and `:desktop:applePlayerRenderCheck` exits 0 (`1280x800: mean brightness 0,06, 7518 ink px in the column, 8857 in the lyrics`, `640x800: 0 ink px right of the column`). **Watch:** an artwork's shadow is `shadow(elevation, CookieShapes.fourSided)`, never a `RoundedCornerShape` around it. **Open sub-item:** the render check paints the screen without a cover in its fixture, so the shadow is verified as the modifier over the cookie and by the compile, not as measured pixels under the artwork.

### 📝 Commits
- v6.0.8.11_DE-1.56.5-beta: a cookie shadow under the Apple player

---

list.name: Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.4
list.body:
## Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.4
**Release channel:** `beta`

### 🔧 Changed
- [DE] **Every cover in the desktop edition is the 4-sided cookie, so a picture has one shape wherever it is drawn.** The cookie had reached an artist's card and a song's row cover; every other cover kept a corner of the shape scale - an album's and a playlist's card, the detail headers, the player's big artwork in both designs, the mini player, the queue and history rows, the now-playing window and a recognition's result - so one idea came out as a corner on some surfaces and a cookie on others, and an artist was the only card in a row of cards that read as a cookie. The shape now comes from `Thumbnail`'s own default (`CookieShapes.fourSided`), so a call site that says nothing inherits it instead of starting from a corner, and `YtItemCard`, `GradientHeader`'s artwork and `PlayerThumbnail` state the cookie where they draw it; the `corner` parameter of `PlayerThumbnail` and `QueueRowArtwork` is gone with it, because a radius is not what that shape is made of. The boxes that clipped or shadowed an artwork with a corner carry the cookie too (`shadow(24.dp,...)` over the player's artwork, the title scrim, the reflection under it, the mini player's box, the now-playing window's, the history rows'), so none of them squares the picture off behind it - the wrapper was what made the largest cover in the app read as a square even where the picture under it was already the cookie. What the rotating-artwork option does is turn the cover; the shape is the same with it on and off. **Measured:** `:desktop:compileKotlin` passes; `:desktop:cookieShapesCheck` still reads 38797 / 42970 / 38485 painted pixels for the three shapes; `:desktop:playerDesignRenderCheck`, `:desktop:applePlayerRenderCheck` and `:desktop:playerAudioCardCheck` exit 0, the Apple player at 1280x800 reading `mean brightness 0,06, 7518 ink px in the column, 8857 in the lyrics` and 0 ink right of the column at 640x800. **Watch:** a new artwork is a `Thumbnail` or a `PlayerThumbnail`, never a box with a corner and an image inside it, and a card whose cover should round its corners under the pointer takes `rememberArtistCookie`. **Open sub-item:** no check here can move a pointer, so the hover morph on an album's or a playlist's card is the same `rememberArtistCookie` an artist's card already had, verified through the shape it hands to the cover rather than by hovering each card.

### 📝 Commits
- v6.0.8.11_DE-1.56.4-beta: the 4-sided cookie on every cover
- docs: note the now-playing artwork's cookie
- docs: note the cookie covers in the preview

---
This release was built automatically from commit `109959ea1f99b25d753a8de703f7c6620bd08ee9`.

list.name: Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.3
list.body:
## Vivi Music 6.0.8.11_DE 1.56.3
**Release channel:** `beta`

### ✨ Added
- [DE] **Every icon button in the desktop edition lifts and turns its glyph under the pointer.** The movement existed only on the player's transport and the round glass buttons, so the app's icon buttons - the top bar, the rows' trailing actions, the dialogs' close buttons, Listen Together's approve and reject, the window controls - were the one surface where the pointer did nothing to the glyph. All 76 `IconButton` call sites in the 16 files that held them are drawn through `M3IconButton` now: the same composable underneath, with the same click target, ripple, state layers, colours and padding, whose content sits inside `LiftedGlyph` (2 dp up and -6 degrees on the 0,6 s decelerating curve, `Modifier.iconHoverLift`). One wrapper decides the movement instead of a modifier copied 76 times, and a glyph added later cannot be drawn without it; the two buttons that are not that wrapper (Listen Together's send and the Basic player's play, both `FilledIconButton`) wrap their glyph in `LiftedGlyph` themselves, with the same `enabled` their button has. The unused `androidx.compose.material3.IconButton` imports went with the rename. **Measured:** `:desktop:compileKotlin` and `:desktop:compileTestKotlin` pass, `:desktop:motionCheck` exits 0 with `icon hover: 416 px differ between rest and lifted`, and the UI preview mirrors it: a `:is(...)` rule over its icon-button classes reads 0,6 s / `cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1)` on a top-bar icon, a labelled `rail-row` keeps a still glyph, and `motion_check.mjs` and `styles_check.mjs` exit 0. **Watch:** a new icon button is an `M3IconButton`, never a bare `IconButton`, and a button of another M3 family wraps its glyph in `LiftedGlyph`. **Open sub-item:** nothing here can hover a button headlessly, so the movement is verified through its rendered end state and the preview's computed style, not by moving a pointer over every one of the 78 buttons.

### 📝 Commits
- v6.0.8.11_DE-1.56.3-beta: every icon button lifts its glyph
- docs: note the square card covers in the preview

---
This release was built automatically from commit `6b6c65d174f07865be4bce43d78aa5f78088975d`.
